  "summary": "WHAT IT IS. Two functions. (1) claimOrphanOrgRows (packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-orphan-org-rows.ts:62) walks every registered object that is not managedBy, not sys_-prefixed and declares organization_id. It reads up to 10 000 rows WHERE organization_id IS NULL as isSystem, then writes organization_id = <new org> one id at a time. It is reached from one place: Middleware B in organizations-plugin.ts (Fallback A, lines 449-466), after a sys_organization insert, only when the per-org seed replay landed 0 rows (inserted + updated = 0) AND the organization count read just after the insert is 1, i.e. the first organization the store ever holds. That count, read at limit 2, is the only idempotency guard. The header's sentence 'Idempotent: a no-op once an organization-tagged row exists' describes a check the code does not make. (2) claimOrgSeedOwnership (claim-org-seed-ownership.ts) is NOT an organization_id writer. It sets owner_id on rows the org's own seed replay reported landing on (seededRecordIds, ADR-0138 D1), scoped organization_id = org. It runs from the default-org owner bind, takes nothing from claimOrphanOrgRows, and does not depend on it. Only its header prose names it. WHO MOUNTS IT. os serve and os dev mount OrganizationsPlugin only when the posture is not single (packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:4359, multiTenant = tenancyPosture !== 'single'), and the plugin entitles only group and isolated (supportedPostures). So under single the claim is not composed at all. CAN IT FIND A ROW? Only one population reaches it: a walled store whose first organization is created while it holds NULL-organization rows on app objects, with a replay that lands nothing. No store this release produces holds such a row. Every write through the engine is stamped or refused (D9, Engine.resolveSystemInsertOrganization: derived under single, refused under a wall, refused under single with the organization object registered and no organization). 18.0.0 (06cab4849a) already had both halves. A table the driver creates since 7b-0 refuses the row at NOT NULL, measured below. A v17 or pre-release store boots only certified, and certification holds every unattributable row against it. Measured per store below: 0 rows claimable on every store this release produces or serves. OVERLAP AND DISAGREEMENT. Yes. The claim's population (application objects, not sys_, not managedBy) is exactly the ceremony's APPLICATION_OBJECT_FATE population (organization-ownership-inventory.ts:272, fate 3 'attribution', anchors: []). Under single, the ceremony gives a NULL row to the Default Organization. Under a wall, no anchor names an owner, so the row is reported, left NULL and held against certification (organization-ownership-apply.ts UNATTRIBUTABLE_REMEDY: 'the ceremony never guesses an owner'). The claim gives that same row to whichever organization is created first. They agree under single, where the claim is not composed. They disagree under a wall, where the claim is composed. Reproduced end to end on a hand-made store (below): the ceremony refused to attribute 11 rows, then a real os dev boot gave all 11 to the first organization. DEPENDENTS. None. Neither shipped example (app-showcase, app-crm) declares @objectstack/organizations, so a walled os dev of either is refused at boot (measured). In a walled host that does declare it, an app with seeds always replays (+132 in the group boot) and returns before Fallback A. Its tests are claim-orphan-org-rows.test.ts, 8 cases against a mock engine. No test drives Fallback A through the plugin. Its other references are bookkeeping and prose (list under 'retirement_cut').",

Seat decision · epic PM `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-22T14:10Z. **Recommendation A (retire) is taken.** The measurement is os-dev-report 6342754850, on `origin/main` `03de83b0`. The seat re-checked its two load-bearing facts on `f2ade4afb0`:
- the claim is reached only from `organizations-plugin.ts`'s Fallback A, and only when the organization count is 1 (`:449-466`);
- `os serve` composes `OrganizationsPlugin` only when the posture is not `single` (`serve.ts:4359`).

**Why A:**
- **The defect, reproduced on a store a walled 18.x can boot.** The store is an 18.0.0-born copy with 11 `showcase_task` rows set to NULL organization.
  - Under `isolated`, the ceremony marked all 11 rows unattributable and refused to certify.
  - A seedless isolated boot of the un-ceremonied copy, voluntary on an 18.0.0-born store, then gave the 11 rows to the first organization: "claimed 11 orphan seed row(s)".
  - That is an owner by guess. D10 fate 4 says it is never guessed; D9 says nothing defaults to any owner other than the derivable one.
- **Nothing to keep it for.** No passage allows it (B), and folding it into the ceremony (C) would duplicate `single`'s Default Organization or reverse fate 4 under a wall.
- **Dependents:** none in the shipped examples; only 8 mock-engine tests.

**State:** this card becomes the build. Its title moves from `measure(…)` to `fix(…)!`. The cut list is the report's.
- Delete the function, its test, Fallback A and its log line.
- Remove the `index.ts` export: `patch`, with a BREAKING banner, migration lines and the ADR-0087 marker.
- Update the pinned engine-double contract and regenerate the census row with its script.
- Fix the README row and the prose in five files.

The measurement session is archived. The seat dispatches the build into the free slot (concurrency cap 2) with a new claim.
